content:
maria: FYI ShadowBox asked for an assurance bundle for the POC: short SOC2 excerpt for Storage/Access controls, a signed vuln-attestation we can issue, redacted network diagram, and permission for their external scanner to hit staging. They also asked if presigned URLs or ephemeral KMS creds change Dedicated pricing. Need ops/security/legal confirmation + lead times.

ezra: I can produce the redacted diagram and SOC2 excerpt (we pull the Storage control pages). For presigned uploads we provide example commands and 24h TTL by default. Example we hand to customers: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-proofpack/shadowbox/drop.zip --expires-in 86400`.

olivia: Security checklist: third-party scans allowed only with signed NDA, defined test window, IP allowlist, staging-only, and scoped bucket prefix. We do NOT hand over persistent service keys; only presigned URLs or short-lived STS tokens. We can create a scoped staging API key for auth tests but it must be timeboxed and rotated after the test. Ops needs 24-48h to create/revoke.

ops-bot: Action items generated -> attach SOC2 excerpt PDF, redacted-diagram.png, attestation-template.docx. Required approvals: Security + Legal.

je:henry (Legal): I'll review the attestation wording. We cannot commit to fixed remediation windows in the attestation unless it's in contract. We should keep remediation language high-level and reference standard SLAs. If customer insists on contractual remediation timelines or liability language, Sales should escalate for contract addendum. Turnaround: 2 business days after draft.

jake (CISO): I can sign the attestation once Legal approves wording. Attestation will state scope, allowed IPs, test window, and that we consent to the scan and will triage critical findings. No promises beyond SLA.

maria: Pricing question from buyer: "Will issuing presigned URLs or ephemeral KMS creds bump Dedicated pricing or require a new quote?"

ezra: Short answer: no for standard usage (presigned URLs, STS tokens, short-lived API keys). If they require VPC peering, cross-account networking, or dedicated relay infra we have to quote one-time setup and may require higher reserved capacity. Also note: heavy sustained scanner traffic could trigger normal autoscaling and usage billing. I'll draft a pricing blurb to attach.

olivia: Also call out security ops work needed (setup allowlist, coordinate test window) which we estimate at ~2-4 engineer-hours for early engagement; include that as an optional setup fee if they want us to manage the scan.

maria: Great. ShadowBox will provide tester CV, IP list, and exact scope by Wednesday. Preferred attestation format?

je:henry (Legal): docx is fine. Use our attestation template and populate scope/test window.

ops-bot: Template path: /Assurance/attestation-template-v2.docx (internal).

maria: Plan: 1) collect NDA + tester details, 2) attach SOC2 excerpt + redacted diagram, 3) send draft attestation + pricing note to ShadowBox by Fri EOD. @olivia please draft attestation language, @ezra pricing blurb, @henry legal review, @jake final sign-off.

ezra: Will add the pricing clarifier: "No pricing change for presigned URLs or ephemeral tokens. VPC peering/dedicated infra requires quote; heavy scan traffic billed as normal usage."

olivia: I'll include rotation requirement for any test keys, IP allowlist, staging-only restriction, and a line that we will triage critical issues but will not provide SLA-level remediation commitments in the attestation.

maria: Thanks team. I'll update ShadowBox once docs are uploaded. :white_check_mark: (attachments planned: SOC2-excerpt-storage.pdf, redacted-netdiag-v1.png, attestation-draft.docx)
